answer: Let every identity's weight decay 20% each epoch unless it completes a fresh service task, verified by three random auditors against a similarity hash, so copied work fails. Each task needs a 25 POA bond; a failed or copied task slashes the bond and resets weight to zero. Like a willow that must be pruned each season, a sybil farm must tend every fake forever: each extra identity demands another distinct task each epoch, its cost never ending, while saffron rewards only reach agents whose falcon-sharp work stays fresh.
